headline: "First principle: no investing in domestic stocks"… ants heading to US stocks [Leverage aftermath ②]
summary: Disillusionment among South Korean individual investors has peaked after leveraged single-stock ETFs exposed the domestic market to extreme volatility. Some investors are moving to US stocks.
why: Retail capital flows between Korean and US markets affect liquidity in the Korean market and demand for US-listed shares.
